0022600088.text: Both the Chicago Bulls and Toronto Raptors are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Bulls visiting Toronto. For Chicago, Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury, and Isaac Okoro, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, with Collins recovering from toe surgery. For Toronto, Brandon Ingram is out after Achilles surgery and Nate Bittle is day-to-day with a foot injury, while the Bulls lost all three of their 2025-26 meetings with the Raptors, most recently 139-109 in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
